errors.evidence: The description does not mention the tick interval for the x-axis, which is 2 years.
The description does not mention the tick interval for the y-axis, which is 0.1.

The solid line does not have any data point markers; it only has vertices. The dotted line is a line style composed of dots. Describing both lines as having circular markers is an incorrect hallucination of a visual feature for the solid line.

Describing the solid line's movement after 1948 as fluctuating between 3.2 and 3.3 is an over-generalization. The line frequently goes above 3.3, reaching values close to 3.4 multiple times before 1988.
The peak value of the solid line in 1988 is approximately 3.45, not 3.48. The stated value is overly precise and inaccurate.
The final value of the solid line in 2018 is approximately 2.95. The value 2.88 corresponds to the minimum point in 2016, not the end point in 2018.
The description incorrectly states that the dotted line 'fluctuates' (波动). The dotted line represents a smooth trend, not a fluctuating series of data points.
The dotted line does not stabilize at 3.25 in 2018. Its value in 2018 is much lower, around 2.95.
The dotted line does not stabilize ('稳定在') at the end of the period; it shows a clear and continuous downward trend.
